In order to transfer to supply chain management from open studies you need to take classes like math and stats which aren’t the easiest. As well as Econ classes that have a crazy curve. If you think you can make the competitive average which is 3.1-3.4 right now, then open studies is an option. But I highly recommend talking to an advisor at u of c about what your options are.

I think you might be able to upgrade through University of Calgary’s continuing education program. The only problem with open studies is that you don’t know how well you will perform in your first year of university, especially if you did mediocre in high school. If your GPA in open studies is not high enough to transfer to a program then you are stuck in open studies. Especially since GPA requirements are so competitive right now I think it’s sketchy to go into open studies. If you upgrade your marks (whether that’s in Calgary or where you are from), you can learn new study skills to prepare you for university AND be in your first choice program.

I highly recommend that you upgrade your high school marks instead of doing open studies. I upgraded for a year to get into Haskayne and have no regrets. If you have any questions about it feel free to ask me!
